company.name: Simbie AI
company.shortDescription: Simbie AI provides AI voice agents that automate patient calls, scheduling, intake, and clinical documentation for healthcare practices.
company.description: Simbie AI develops AI voice agents that act as virtual medical staff for healthcare practices. Its platform handles inbound and outbound patient calls, registration, scheduling, refill requests, and pre-visit intake while integrating directly with EMR and EHR systems. The system also supports medication reconciliation, prior-authorization workflows, and automated chart documentation from patient interactions. Simbie AI is designed for independent and multi-site medical practices that want to reduce administrative workload, standardize front-desk operations, and maintain continuous patient access. The company offers healthcare-specific workflows, including triage-focused intake, perioperative coordination, and follow-up outreach to keep patients connected between visits.
